en: The image depicts a snowy street lined with traditional buildings on the left, with snow covering the roofs and street. There are a few people and a horse-drawn sleigh or cart in the distance. The view looks out over a river or valley to the right, bordered by trees. The colors and style suggest an old photograph, possibly colorized. The lower right corner contains text that appears to read 'RØROS, SØRTRØNDELAG.'
